item.title: Fly Tipped Crap STILL THERE!, 20th September
item.description:
The attached photos were taken today (20th September). On the 18th September, the council updated FixMyStreet ref: 10044748 to say the problem had been fixed. As you can see from the attached photos, that's a COMPLETE FUCKING LIE! Once again, the council is bullshitting people! How can a problem be fixed, when the shit all over the grass is STILL THERE! Every single fucking time I report a flytip at this location, some stupid cunt at the council falsely marks it as fixed! I told you in the last report not to do that. But you did it anyway. I told you that the waste had details of who dumped it! And what have you done? Fuck all apart from lying! I even made sure the pin is in the exact location where the waste is. And what have you done? Just fucking left it there. This is the same thing you do every time a report is made here! And if the council is getting offended by my language then perhaps they can actually do the job they are paid to do, and not let litter and waste accumulate on council owned land. And if you still can't be fucked with collecting it, the next step will be for me to start action under Section 91 of Environmental Protection Act 1990!

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Wren Path, Thamesmead
Report on FixMyStreet
